sources.title: Twitter Sentiment Analysis using DistilBERT - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project performs sentiment analysis on Twitter data using the DistilBERT pre-trained transformer model from Hugging Face's Transformers library. The goal is to classify the sentiment of tweets into three categories: Positive, Neutral, and Negative.

sources.title: Social Sentiment Insights using a DistilBERT Model
sources.snippet: This study combines sentiment analysis, emoji sentiment detection, and spam detection to address the challenge of analyzing user comments on social media. It makes use of a fine-tuned DistilBERT model that classifies comments as Positive, Negative, or Neutral in sentiment and maps spam classes to identify the harmful or irrelevant content. sources.title: Sentiment Analyzer - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🎭 Sentiment Analyzer An NLP-powered web application that leverages a fine-tuned DistilBERT model to perform high-accuracy sentiment analysis on text data. Perfect for analyzing customer reviews, social media comments, or feedback at scale.
